statement: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED DGS10) prints at or above 5.00 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-27. Reference: 4.99 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 shows a value of 5.00 or higher for any observation dated between 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-27 inclusive. Reference level at seal: 4.99.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 observation dated between 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-27 is below 5.00 percent.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee raises the federal funds target range by at least 50 basis points at its meeting concluding 2026-12-09.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-12-10 is at least 0.50 percentage points above its value for 2026-11-10.
failure_condition: The upper bound of the target range on 2026-12-10 is less than 0.50 percentage points above its 2026-11-10 level.

statement: The WTI Cushing spot price falls below 80.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04. Reference: 85.63 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if EIA daily series RWTC (FRED DCOILWTICO) shows any value below 80.00 for dates between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04 inclusive. Reference level at seal: 85.63.
failure_condition: Every daily WTI Cushing spot value dated between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04 is at or above 80.00 dollars.

statement: Anthropic files a final IPO prospectus between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04 with an offering price between 70.00 and 78.00 dollars per share inclusive.
resolution: TRUE if SEC EDGAR carries an Anthropic Rule 424B4 prospectus with filing date between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04 stating an initial public offering price from 70.00 to 78.00 dollars inclusive.
failure_condition: Anthropic does not price its IPO between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04, or prices it below 70.00 or above 78.00 dollars per share.

statement: The US House of Representatives adopts at least one article of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in a floor vote held between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if the Clerk of the House roll call record on Congress.gov shows adoption of a resolution containing an article of impeachment against Hegseth with a vote date between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-20.
failure_condition: The House does not adopt any article of impeachment against Hegseth between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-20, including because the measure is tabled, referred, defeated or not voted on.

statement: CISA adds at least one Google Chromium or Chrome vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-27.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog carries an entry with vendor Google and product containing Chromium or Chrome with a date-added value between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-27 inclusive.
failure_condition: CISA adds no Google Chromium or Chrome vulnerability to the KEV catalog between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-27.

statement: CISA adds at least one Barracuda Email Security Gateway vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-01.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog carries an entry with vendor Barracuda Networks and product Email Security Gateway with a date-added value between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-01 inclusive.
failure_condition: CISA adds no Barracuda Email Security Gateway vulnerability to the KEV catalog between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-01.

statement: Russia and Ukraine sign a ceasefire or peace agreement between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters and AP both report that representatives of the Russian and Ukrainian governments signed a ceasefire or peace agreement on a date between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: Russian and Ukrainian government representatives do not sign any ceasefire or peace agreement between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11.

statement: The United States and Iran both publicly confirm a ceasefire or cessation of hostilities that takes effect between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters and AP both report that the US and Iranian governments each confirmed a ceasefire or cessation of hostilities with an effective date between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04.
failure_condition: No ceasefire or cessation of hostilities confirmed by both the US and Iranian governments takes effect between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 300 km of the epicenter of USGS event us7000tx16 near Lata, Solomon Islands, between 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-25.
resolution: TRUE if the USGS ComCat catalog lists an event of magnitude 6.0 or greater, origin time between 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-25 UTC, with epicenter within 300 km of event us7000tx16.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 300 km of the us7000tx16 epicenter between 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-25 UTC.
